obligations.text: spec-spine.toml is version-only when both the merge base and the head hold it, the two copies are equal once the required_version line is masked, and the head's required_version, less a leading `=`, equals the version the head's root Cargo.toml declares in [workspace.package] or [package].

A changed spec.md is the owning spec, ignored like a generated path, when its front matter, the lines between an opening `---` and the next `---`, contains a policy path of this change that is not version-only, in double or single quotes; any other spec.md is other.
The remote obligations do not require branches up to date, and the profile's gate and workflow comments do not assume merge commits.
The guard's exits and its merge-base comparison are spec 044's; its summary line also counts the owning-spec paths.

sectionHeadings: 072: Setup profile revision 28: the policy-isolation guard ignores a self-pin and the owning spec
3.3 The remote obligations and the comments
record.summary: Amends spec 044 section 3.3, spec 071 and spec 002's setup profile. A repository that pins spec-spine to its own version, as spec-spine does, moves spec-spine.toml with every release, so its release bump stays mixed under revision 27; and a policy file that a spec claims needs that spec's spec.md beside it under the coupling gate, which the guard calls other. Revision 28 treats a self-pin move as version-only and a spec.md whose front matter names a changed policy path as an ignored owning spec. It also drops "branches up to date" from the remote obligations and the gate's comments that assumed merge commits.
record.title: Setup profile revision 28: the policy-isolation guard ignores a self-pin and the owning spec
